subject: Operations
title: Supplier Quality Management
description: A 60-second lesson on Supplier Quality Management.

hook.text: Your product is only as good as its worst supplier. One bad bolt can ground an entire fleet of aircraft.

buildup.text: Supplier quality management ensures incoming materials meet your standards before they enter production.

discovery.text: Methods include supplier audits, incoming inspection, scorecards, and collaborative improvement programs.

twist.text: Punishing bad suppliers creates fear and hidden defects. Partnering with them creates lasting improvement.

climax.text: Toyota works with suppliers for decades, sharing knowledge. The result: a network of world-class partners.

quiz.question: How does Toyota manage supplier quality?
options: Through long-term partnership and knowledge sharing
